ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This image is a schematic diagram of plant cell structure titled “PLANT CELL STRUCTURE”; the image labels many cell structures, including mitochondrion, ribosomes, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, chloroplast, vacuole, nucleus, nucleolus, etc.; in the lower-left part inside the cell there is a structure labeled “Microbody”. Reasoning: The question asks “which organelle is enclosed by a single membrane and contains enzymes”. In cell biology, a microbody (microbody, such as peroxisome, glyoxysome) is an organelle surrounded by a single membrane and containing many enzymes inside. Therefore the answer matching the definition in the question stem is microbody.
